premises.text: Parents often cannot recall critical kids' medical details in emergencies or for daycare requests
premises.evidence_span: they constantly ask you for this information. Daycare, sports team, it doesn't matter. You always need to have access to it, and it's annoying

premises.text: Law gives patients ownership of records and obliges timely doctor release after signing
premises.evidence_span: you now own your medical records. And once a proper release is signed, a doctor has to provide it to you in a timely fashion

premises.text: Mother Nose is a full-service, no-effort, parent-centric PHR focused on immunizations, growth, and milestones
premises.evidence_span: Mother knows it's full service, it's no effort, and it's consumer-centric targeted at parents

premises.text: Faxed records are ingested and uploaded by customer service after an electronic release
premises.evidence_span: We've built a system to ingest all these faxes. Our customer service team will take out all the data layers that you just guys saw, and we will upload it for you

premises.text: HIPAA compliance plus extra security layers reassure cautious parents
premises.evidence_span: we are HIPAA compliant. And actually, we've added extra special layers of security to make sure that even the most cautious of parents will feel good with it

premises.text: Subscription of about a latte per month distributed via co-marketing with baby sites
premises.evidence_span: we are already working on some co-marketing partnerships with them

value.text: Put kids' critical medical information in parents' pockets anytime, anywhere
value.evidence_span: all your kid's critical medical information available to you in your pocket, accessible anytime, from anywhere

starting with those who need it most, busy, caring moms
